1OxfT.rationale: Rxg2 moves the f2 rook off the f-file. Rxf1+ is blocked on the original board and legal if that rook moves. After Rxf1+ Qxf1 Rxf1+ Kxf1 the exchange has recovered the bishop offer and leaves 170 material centipawns above the starting balance.

0RYob.rationale: After Qxe1+ Nxe1 Rxe1#, returning the accepted f3 knight to f3 on the payoff board permits Nxe1. This is both clearance and a mating deflection.

033eV.rationale: After Rxh6+ Bxh6, restoring the bishop to g7 on the payoff board stops Qf7 from giving check. The actual line forces Bg7 Rh1#. Clearance and displacement both contribute.

0yKNX.rationale: The existing classifier gives a branch after ...fxe3. The selected Stockfish line uses ...Qxe3. The old label does not enter the exact-line score on this case.
